intent: Approach the rural station, ride moving cargo through the railway, and race out into open country. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The quiet meadow
sections.lesson: Find the station beyond the fences. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
